name: Kuma (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kuma village emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kuma, a village in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1954.

features.role: Kuma village emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
